title: Golden Canadian Crepes with Kissed Maple Syrup
description: Delicate golden crepes filled with a sweet and savory kissed maple syrup and a hint of Canadian flavor.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup kissed maple syrup
ingredients.notes: grade A pure Canadian maple syrup

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons Canadian oil
ingredients.notes: such as canola or grapeseed oil

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together non-dairy milk, Canadian oil, and vanilla extract.
Add powdered sugar and whisk until dissolved.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Brush the pan with a small amount of Canadian oil.
Pour a small amount of crepe batter into the pan and tilt to evenly coat.
Cook for 1-2 minutes or until the edges start to curl.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and flip.
Cook for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute or until lightly browned.
To assemble, place a crepe on a serving plate and drizzle with kissed maple syrup.
